from pathlib import Path
import datetime,errno,hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,socket,subprocess,time

work=Path.cwd()
root=Path('/Users/suas/work/orchestrat0r/ai-orchestrator')
scratch=work/'_scratch/mimo-review'
evidence=work/'docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-review-fixes'
report=root/'docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_livetest.md'
plan=root/'docs/plans/2026-10-27-mimo-stale-session-warning_plan.md'
profile=Path('/tmp/aio-lt-queue-71493f81')
def now():return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
cleanup_retries=[]
def remove_owned_tree(p):
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(p)
            return
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno!=errno.ENOTEMPTY or attempt==2:raise
            cleanup_retries.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(work)) if p.is_relative_to(work) else str(p),attempt=attempt+1,error='ENOTEMPTY',remainingNames=[x.name for x in p.iterdir()]))
            time.sleep(0.2)
def command(args):
    result=subprocess.run(['rtk','proxy',*args],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Final command failed: '+args[0])
    return result.stdout
review=(evidence/'independent-review.txt').read_text()
assert 'VERDICT: PASS' in review, 'Fresh independent review must pass before cleanup'
correction_review=(evidence/'independent-correction-review.txt').read_text()
assert 'VERDICT: PASS' in correction_review, 'Fresh correction review must pass before cleanup'
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (evidence/'command-receipts.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
required=['fresh-typecheck-renderer','fresh-typecheck-spec','fresh-lint','fresh-check-ts-max-loc','fresh-check-ui-hints','fresh-build-main','fresh-build-renderer','fresh-full-suite-final','fresh-acceptance']
for name in required:
    matching=[r for r in rows if r.get('output')==name+'-output.txt']
    assert matching and matching[-1]['exitCode']==0, 'Missing successful fresh check '+name
reports=[]
for p in (work/'_scratch').glob('test-results*.json'):
    try:
        data=json.loads(p.read_text())
        if isinstance(data,dict) and isinstance(data.get('numTotalTests'),int):reports.append((data['numTotalTests'],p.stat().st_mtime,p,data))
    except (ValueError,OSError):pass
assert reports, 'Full-suite raw JSON missing'
_,_,raw,data=max(reports,key=lambda r:(r[0],r[1]))
assert data.get('success') and data.get('numFailedTests')==0
summary={k:data.get(k) for k in ['success','numTotalTestSuites','numPassedTestSuites','numFailedTestSuites','numTotalTests','numPassedTests','numFailedTests','numPendingTests','numTodoTests']}
summary.update(at=now(),source=raw.name)
(evidence/'fresh-full-suite-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
method=json.loads((evidence/'method-receipt.json').read_text())
for entry in method['scripts']:
    p=scratch/entry['name'];assert digest(p)==entry['sha256'],'Method receipt drift: '+entry['name']
original=scratch/'original-node_modules'
assert original.is_dir() and (work/'node_modules').is_dir()
original_inode=original.stat().st_ino
original_lock=digest(original/'.package-lock.json')
for port in [4579,9822,9823]:
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.settimeout(1);assert sock.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',port))!=0, 'Owned runtime still listening'
for row in [json.loads(line) for line in (evidence/'runtime-receipts.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]:
    if row['event']=='started':
        try:os.kill(row['pid'],0)
        except ProcessLookupError:pass
        else:raise RuntimeError('Owned runtime PID still present')
sources=[('root',report),('root',plan),('queue',work/'docs/plans/livetest-remediation-register.md'),('queue',work/'src/main/core/system/provider-quota-service.ts'),('queue',work/'src/main/core/system/provider-quota-service.spec.ts')]
def seal(state):
    entries=[dict(checkout=role,path=str(p.relative_to(root if role=='root' else work)),sha256=digest(p)) for role,p in sources]
    files=[dict(path=str(p.relative_to(evidence)),sha256=digest(p)) for p in sorted(evidence.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name!='verification-seal.json']
    (evidence/'verification-seal.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(at=now(),state=state,sources=entries,evidence=files,priorSeals='Historical and unchanged. Current hashes are supplied here for corrected source/report bytes.'),indent=2)+'\n')
seal('Evidence sealed before owned runtime deletion')
# Restore the original root directory first. Remove the retired temporary install
# outside the active dependency path; the first attempt left only .DS_Store.
retired=scratch/'temporary-node_modules-to-remove'
assert not retired.exists()
os.rename(work/'node_modules',retired)
os.rename(original,work/'node_modules')
assert (work/'node_modules').stat().st_ino==original_inode
assert digest(work/'node_modules/.package-lock.json')==original_lock
remove_owned_tree(retired)
removed=[]
for p in [profile,work/'dist',work/'.angular']:
    if p.exists():remove_owned_tree(p);removed.append(str(p.relative_to(work)) if p.is_relative_to(work) else str(p))
# No scratch directory existed when this correction began. It now contains only
# this run's helpers/caches and the independently executed tests' disposable output.
assert (work/'_scratch').is_dir()
remove_owned_tree(work/'_scratch')
removed.append('_scratch (helpers, npm/Electron/native caches and raw test runtime)')
status=command(['git','status','--short'])
staged=command(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'])
assert not staged.strip(), 'Unexpected staged paths'
assert command(['git','symbolic-ref','--short','HEAD']).strip()=='queue/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resili-493f81'
command(['git','diff','--check'])
root_plan_status=command(['git','-C',str(root),'status','--short','--','docs/plans/2026-10-27-mimo-stale-session-warning_plan.md'])
assert root_plan_status.startswith('?? '), 'Root follow-up plan must remain untracked'
gitreceipt=dict(at=now(),status=status,stagedPaths=[],rootFollowupPlanStatus=root_plan_status,worktrees=command(['git','worktree','list']),branches=command(['git','branch','--list']))
(evidence/'git-final-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(gitreceipt,indent=2)+'\n')
cleanup=dict(at=now(),removed=removed,temporaryExactInstallRemoved=True,originalDependencyDirectoryRestored=True,originalDirectoryInodeMatches=True,originalInstallLockHashMatches=True,profileAbsent=not profile.exists(),distAbsent=not (work/'dist').exists(),angularCacheAbsent=not (work/'.angular').exists(),scratchAbsent=not (work/'_scratch').exists(),noBranchOrWorktreeCreated=True,coordinatorOwnsCheckout=True,firstAttempt='Retained separately as cleanup-first-attempt.json: only .DS_Store remained after ENOTEMPTY; original install was still preserved.',retries=cleanup_retries)
(evidence/'cleanup-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(cleanup,indent=2)+'\n')
with (evidence/'command-receipts.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(dict(at=now(),command='Owned runtime cleanup, dependency restoration and final Git checks',exitCode=0,output='cleanup-receipt.json'))+'\n')
report.write_text(report.read_text()+f'''

### Handoff and cleanup confirmed — {now()}

Both fresh independent passes returned **VERDICT: PASS**, with no unresolved
actionable findings (`independent-review.txt`, `independent-correction-review.txt`).
The second pass rechecked the corrected documentation and current evidence after
the first review's wording finding; it did not repeat unchanged heavy gates.
The complete final suite output is retained compressed, with a passing secret
scan and verified decompression in `fresh-full-suite-final-log-receipt.json`.

Cleanup is complete: the test app/server and verification process groups are gone;
the disposable profile/databases, temporary exact dependency install, downloaded
Electron binary, generated builds, private caches, scratch helpers and raw runtime
artifacts were removed. The pre-existing dependency directory was moved back
intact, with the same directory identity and install-lock hash. See
`runtime-stopped.json`, `process-groups-stopped.json`,
`fresh-full-suite-final-process.json` and `cleanup-receipt.json`.
`verification-seal.json` covers the corrected report/plan/register/source and all
retained evidence. No commit, staging, branch/worktree change or document rename
was performed. The follow-up plan remains untracked in the root checkout. Evidence
is ready for the coordinator's verification and document closure.
''')
plan.write_text(plan.read_text()+f'''

Final handoff {now()}: both fresh independent passes returned VERDICT: PASS.
Owned runtime, temporary dependencies/binary, builds and private caches were
deleted; the pre-existing dependency directory was restored intact. The owning
report, current evidence seal and cleanup receipt record the actual final state.
This plan remains untracked and retains its active filename for coordinator closure.
''')
seal('Final corrected evidence sealed after successful owned runtime deletion')
current=json.loads((evidence/'verification-seal.json').read_text())
assert all(digest(evidence/entry['path'])==entry['sha256'] for entry in current['evidence'])
print('PASS: fresh canonical checks and independent review; evidence sealed; owned runtime and temporary install removed; original dependencies restored; nothing staged')
correction: First cleanup left only .DS_Store in the temporary dependency directory. Restore original by rename before deleting the retired temporary path; bounded ENOTEMPTY retries record remaining names.
